recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add a Patient.active default-search rule under this issue; any future default-search-parameter policy should be handled as a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13216 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Patient change request from STU3 asking to improve documentation of Patient.active importance when searching and in the safety list. The accepted disposition was to add search-related safety checklist items covering appropriate patient-context default filters and client checking of requested filters, add a search-page link to that safety list, and avoid defining default search parameters as a general mechanism.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit e94790da8dc50112b5be1c946a1daea544ced63c, which added the search safety checklist items to source/safety.html and linked source/search.html to safety.html#search. Commit 76ce9865e683576c6712b6d0c6860272de60ad13 later added the safety checklist CodeSystem and registered it in source/fhir.ini, preserving the search-parameters and default-filters entries in terminology form.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread shows the original concern around omitted Patient.active searches, inactive or entered-in-error records, and risks from servers applying undeclared default filters. FHIR-17726, split from the FHIR-13216 resolution for broader default search parameter guidance, was resolved no-change/considered for future use for R4. FHIR-13224 and FHIR-13339 further support caution around treating meaningWhenMissing or old default-value concepts as search defaults.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active safety page already contains the requested search checklist items, the search page links to the safety checklist and includes self-link guidance for actually applied search parameters, and the active safety checklist CodeSystem mirrors the same entries.
